name: City Hub (Release 26)
body:
- Fixed an issue where full rescan of wallet wouldn't start from the beginning of wallet creation.
- Fixed an issue where full rescan of wallet wouldn't scan the cold staking accounts.

name: City Hub (Release 25)
body: - Improve UI layout for the logo in the menu (top-left), including loading of missing icon.

name: City Hub (Release 24)
body: - Includes latest version of City Chain that contains an important network node connectivity bug fix.

name: City Hub (Release 23)
body:
- Options to change the action when minimizing City Hub. It can either show in task bar, or hide to the tray. The default will continue to be visible, but can be changed in options.
- Automatic startup on computer log in can now be turned on in the settings. This will automatically start City Hub when your computer restarts and you log in.
- Single instance - When starting another instance of City Hub, the existing instance will appear and activate.

name: City Hub (Release 22)
body:
- Adds Content-Security-Policy, which improves the security of loading content into City Hub.
- Update the timeout when "Exit now" appears on shutdown, from 4 seconds to 10 seconds (#125).

name: City Hub (Release 21)
body:
- Updated the ticker, will now show CITY/BTC and BTC/USD.
- Upgraded libaries and dependencies for City Hub.

name: City Hub (Release 20)
body:
- Transaction history is now showing the last 1000 transactions, an increase from 200.
- Shows the count of unspent transaction out (UTXO) and transactions they belong to in the Wallet feature, when advanced mode is enabled.

name: City Hub (Release 19)
body:
- Updates the City Chain daemon (background process) to latest version.
- Updated list of seed nodes, improving connectivity with the network.

name: City Hub (Release 18)
body:
- Add new advanced network feature available under the normal status page. You can add nodes manually, disconnect nodes and ban nodes.
- Improved interaction between City Hub and City Chain (daemon), making it more stable and better.

name: City Hub (Release 17)
body:
- Adds support for snap based installation on Linux.
- This release will be published on the Snap Store: https://snapcraft.io/store
- PRE-RELEASE until final testing is complete.

name: City Hub (Release 16)
body:
- City Chain Insight API adds support for market values, City Hub was updated to get latest prices from the official API.
- Updated with latest City Chain daemon, which includes many bug fixes, performance improvements and updates.
- Improved error handling when unlocking a wallet.
- Reduced amount of API requests, reducing resource utilization by City Hub.

name: City Hub (Release 15)
body:
- Add the City Coin to the ticker on dashboard, market price in both USD and BTC.
- Wallet resync (available in the tools) will add a notification when starting.
- Improved text formatting of releases notes in the update available page.

name: City Hub (Release 14)
body:
- Upgraded UI component, UI refreshed with Material Design 2018 guidelines.
- Upgraded App components to latest releases, improving performance and loading.
- Notification center: The majority of notifications has been moved to a new section on the top right.

name: City Hub (Release 13)
body:
- Add Tools and more About details
- Add tools to get the ExtPubKey.
- Move the Resync from Wallet, to Tools.
- Improve shutdown process of the background daemon.

name: City Hub (Release 12)
body:
- Updates with new network protocol to improve network performance.
- This update require a re-download of the blockchain database. City Hub will automatically remove the folders in your app data folder when starting up the first time, if previously used.
- Includes many bug fixes and improvements to the City Chain.
- This is not a mandatory update, but eventually there will no longer be any nodes available to sync on the old network protocol. Please make sure you install this update, as the previous release might at one time in the future stop syncing with the network.

NOTICE: Please make sure you always keep a backup of your app data folder. At minimum you should ensure you keep a backup of your .wallet.json files located in the CityMain folder.

name: City Hub (Release 11)
body:
- Update to latest daemon
- City Chain release 10 is included in this release of City Hub.
- Minor bug fixes.

name: City Hub (Release 10)
body: - Adds a coin ticker on dashboard, uses Bitcoin until Coincap supports City.

name: City Hub (Release 9)
body:
- Add support for MAIN net mode.
- Fixes issue with shutdown not working properly.
- Improve error handling when communicating with City Chain daemon. Fixes issue with stability.
- Show version on the load and login screen.
- Add support for transaction history reset.
- Temporarily remove a few features from dashboard that is not implemented fully.
